STATUS: pass SUMMARY: I ran about 45 probes across Tabs, Dialog and Combobox, including every extra probe you listed, and none reproduced a failing acceptance criterion. The only reproduced deviation is a minor one: `description=""` renders an `aria-describedby` that points at an empty paragraph. The probe file is deleted and `git status` matches the starting state. FILES TOUCHED: none (the probe file `src/__probe__.test.tsx` was created and deleted; no source or doc edits) FINDINGS: - [minor] `` renders `

` and sets `aria-describedby` to it, because the check only excludes undefined, null and false. D1 says the attribute is present only when a description is given, so an empty string is arguably a bad case. Reproduced: "dialog: description empty string" failed with the attribute present. README's wording ("Omitted when undefined, null or false") matches the code, so the doc is consistent; only the behaviour is questionable. - [minor] `FEATURE_FLOW.md` is listed in FILES but does not exist in the workspace and is not in the diff. None of the acceptance criteria require it, so I did not treat it as a failure. - [minor] Combobox IME guard not really tested. My probe for Enter with `isComposing` had no active option, so it passed trivially. Not reproduced with an active option. - [minor] `Tabs` re-runs `refreshTabs` in a layout effect on every render of every Tab and TabList, with a JSON compare each time. It works, but it is more machinery than the job needs. CHECKS: - `pnpm vitest run src/__probe__.test.tsx` (batch 1, 15 tests) → pass. Covered: Escape closes only the open listbox inside a Dialog; second Escape closes the Dialog; Enter with open listbox in a form does not submit; Enter with closed listbox submits natively; options prop changing while open keeps aria-activedescendant valid; removed active option clears it. - Tabs: two instances with identical values get distinct ids; values with spaces, `_`, `-`, `.`, unicode, `/`, `"`, empty string all give unique ids, and aria-controls/aria-labelledby resolve; selected tab removed from a child component inside TabList falls back to a tabbable tab; selected tab disabled by parent toggle falls back with exactly one tabIndex 0; controlled value naming a removed tab stays tabbable; reorder via parent keeps arrow navigation in DOM order; arrows skip disabled tabs, wrap, and Home/End with disabled ends; all-but-one disabled; single tab; controlled ignoring onValueChange keeps aria-selected; no onValueChange on reselect; Tab from list goes to selected panel; throws outside Tabs. - Dialog: open→close→open returns focus three times; display:none and `hidden` subtrees skipped by focus and trap; Escape in a nested input closes; background cannot be tabbed to; drag from inside to backdrop does not close; mousedown+click on backdrop closes; opener removed before close does not throw; zero focusable keeps focus on dialog; disabled and tabindex=-1 skipped; Shift+Tab from first wraps to last; dialog mounted open returns focus to the prior button; only Escape closes (Enter, letters, ArrowDown, Tab ignored); aria-labelledby → h2; aria-describedby present only with description. - Combobox: regex-like input `(`, `.*`, `[` treated literally; whitespace trimmed; empty-label option; "No results" shown with no activedescendant; keyboard selection skips disabled, wraps, Enter chooses, closes, sets text; clicking disabled option does nothing; Escape restores text without onChange; clearing then Enter/blur does not call onChange; mouse click selects; typing then parent value change resets text; placeholder forwarded and label associated. - README: checked the props and keyboard tables against the code; no mismatches beyond the `description=""` case. OPEN QUESTIONS: Should `description=""` count as "given" (render the paragraph and `aria-describedby`) or be omitted like null and false? Should `FEATURE_FLOW.md` exist, or be dropped from the file list?
